en.disclosure: AI-rendered concepts, for inspiration only. Shapes, holes, accessories and colors may differ from generated models and physical prints. These images do not represent available features, included accessories or verified print results.

en.statusCopy: The current prototype processes images and generates models locally in the browser. The product is being developed around hands-on experience running a 3D-printed toy business.
en.inspirationCopy: A favorite illustration, a geometric composition or a pattern that grows across panels. Explore how color and artwork could become part of the spaces you use every day.
en.description: PegCanvas is a browser-based tool for designing custom multicolor 3D-printable pegboard panels. A working prototype, preparing for its first release.
en.heroCopy: Turn images into modular, multicolor 3D-printable pegboard panels. Arrange your artwork, choose your colors, and make a space that feels like yours.
en.step1Copy: Import PNG, JPEG or SVG. Compare reduced-color previews before adding an image to your layout, while keeping the original source in your project.
en.step3Copy: Preview the generated geometry and export multicolor 3MF files. Save a reusable PegCanvas project to return to your design later.
en.step2Copy: Arrange image layers across modular panels. Move, scale and rotate artwork, then customize the palette for each panel.
en.prototypeAlt: The working PegCanvas prototype, showing pegboard artwork, canvas controls and a read-only 3D preview.
en.inspirationStart: Start with your own image in the browser preview, arrange the panels, then choose a palette for your design.

zh.statusCopy: 目前的原型直接在瀏覽器中處理圖片並生成模型。產品開發結合了經營 3D 列印玩具事業的實務經驗。
zh.inspirationCopy: 喜歡的插畫、幾何構圖，或延伸跨越多塊板件的圖案。讓色彩與創作融入每天生活的空間。
zh.description: PegCanvas 是在瀏覽器中設計專屬多色 3D 列印洞洞板的工具。目前開放原型預覽，正朝首次發布邁進。
zh.heroCopy: 將圖片化為模組化的多色 3D 列印洞洞板。安排圖案、挑選配色，讓日常空間展現你的風格。
zh.step1Copy: 匯入 PNG、JPEG 或 SVG，先比較減色預覽效果，再加入畫布。作品檔會保留原始來源圖片。
zh.step3Copy: 預覽生成模型並匯出多色 3MF 檔案。儲存 PegCanvas 作品檔，就能隨時回來繼續設計。
zh.step2Copy: 在模組化板件上安排圖片圖層，自由移動、縮放、旋轉圖案，並自訂每塊板件的配色。
